_meta.coords: normalized 0-1 over the game's content area (window minus title bar); [x0, y0, x1, y1] boxes, [x, y] points
_meta.source: measured on windowed 1470x830 pt (2x) frames, Monkey Meadow: fixtures_full/ + live Easy Sandbox (step 3.1)

buttons._notes: powers opens the powers list in a game; in Sandbox the same button toggles the bloon-sending panel and the tower shop. play_ff = Space (confirmed). sandbox_send_round: the green play button next to 'Set round' on the Sandbox bloon panel; it sends that round. In Sandbox neither Space nor play_ff starts a round (2026-11-05).

shop._notes: Cell i of 'order' sits in row i//2, column i%2. 6 rows fit. Scroll with HID wheel events over scroll_point: after scrolling all the way up, rows 0-5 show (row r at top_row0_y + r*row_pitch); after scrolling all the way down, rows 8-13 show (row r at bottom_row13_y - (13-r)*row_pitch). Only towers without a hotkey (desperado: top layout; mermonkey, skywarden: bottom layout) need clicks.

upgrade_panel._notes: The panel opens on the side opposite the selected tower; find the side with the sell_button template. Left = right shifted by -dx in x (sell_button centres 0.7959 vs 0.1823). ability_icon is the big icon shown next to the panel when the selection has an activated ability (not a dx shift). Towers without targeting (e.g. Tack) show no targeting label. Hero panel: the path rows are replaced by hero_level / hero_level_up / hero_level_price; sell is the same.

ability_bar._notes: Bottom-left, one icon per activated ability, left to right; the bottom of each icon is cut off by the screen edge. chevron collapses/expands the bar. With the panel open on the left the whole bar moves right by panel_left_dx. Ready = full-colour icon; after use a full orange ring appears over a darkened icon and shrinks as the cooldown runs (2026-11-05). icon_half: crop half-size around a slot point (bottom clipped at the screen edge); used_min_diff: mean |diff| of that crop that counts as 'the ability fired' (~32 seen vs ~5 frame noise). Key '1' confirmed for slot 0; others see hotkeys.ability.

pause._notes: Open with Escape (with nothing selected) or Backquote; it zooms in, so wait ~0.8 s before reading or clicking. Same layout in Standard and Sandbox.

menus._notes: difficulty_*: the 3 medallions on the difficulty screen (y 0.374). back: the arrow at the top left of the map-select and difficulty screens (2026-11-05). Leaving a game through pause -> Home asks nothing: a 'Loading...' screen, then home in ~4 s. overwrite_save_*: 'Overwrite save?' popup after choosing a mode when that map/difficulty has a saved game (same layout as the restart confirm); Cancel goes back to mode select.

map_select._notes: Beginner map grid: 6 thumbnails per page (2 rows x 3), slots in reading order, each with its name above (slot point + name_dy, +-name_half). Map select reopens on the LAST map's page (not the first; corrected 2026-11-05). next_page / prev_page wrap around all ~17 pages (Beginner -> ... -> Expert -> Beginner), and category_beginner isn't a reliable 'first page'. So new_game reads the names, works out the current page from any map in 'maps' it sees (page = Beginner page index), flips toward the target's page, and clicks once the name shows (forward for up to cycle_pages if no known map is in view). Names OCR only with name_half 0.105 x 0.035 (a bare 'LOGS' reads as nothing in a tighter box); results carry junk ('TREE STUMP 10'), so the match is 'contains'. A green floppy icon at a thumbnail's top-left marks a map with a saved game. Sandbox is locked on maps not yet beaten (Tree Stump): use Standard there.

hotkeys._notes: Keys confirmed in game (RESEARCH hotkey table). Tower keys are towers.json 'hotkey' (null = unbound: click the shop cell). Not listed = not confirmed: click instead (rule in RESEARCH). Ability keys 1-0/-/= are untested. 'ability': slot i's key (only confirmed ones are listed; the game's defaults are 1-0, -, =).

targeting._notes: Targeting label = towers.json stats.targeting mode with '_' -> ' ', upper case, unless listed in 'labels'. Tab (hotkey targeting_next) cycles forward; upgrades can add modes, so set_targeting reads the label after each press. Point modes: after choosing the mode, its label is a green button at the same spot; clicking it closes the panel and shows a 'Click to set ...' banner; then 'points' map clicks, after which the panel reopens (2026-11-05, Mortar / Heli). targeting_label boxes made 0.02 wider / 0.022 taller so two-line labels (FOLLOW MOUSE, LOCK IN PLACE) OCR.

prompts._notes: handle_prompts(): state.read_screen kind -> default click (a 'section.key' point in this file), or null = report only and leave it (outcomes: the env decides). Overridable per harness (h.prompt_actions) or per call. Pause -> Continue because the game pauses itself when it loses focus (RESEARCH 1.5). Restart confirm -> Cancel: restarting is new_game/restart's job (4.9).
